assets.title: A letter defined by shapes
assets.caption: R’s construction from src/geometry.py, with bowl(p_outer, p_inner) expanded into its two paint calls. Each highlighted line previews a path or applies a fill. The outer path is painted gold, then the inner path is painted green.

assets.title: Preparing the letters to connect
assets.caption: I, J, L, and T in the Original and Connected fonts at identical flag-core dimensions. Dotted red outlines on the Connected forms mark the original gold silhouettes.

assets.title: The two automatic color choices
assets.caption: B in BG and GB: the two forms selected for ordinary letters by automatic color matching. The gold outline stays the same while the incoming and outgoing fields swap colors.

assets.title: Matching the colors in JAMAICA
assets.caption: Identical geometry and spacing in both states. Only the color choices change, matching each letter’s incoming field to its neighbor’s outgoing field.

assets.title: Two color exceptions
assets.caption: W alternates across five regions and returns to its incoming color. X always keeps the original flag.

assets.title: Spacing and joining RELAXED
assets.caption: Before: uniform six-design-pixel gaps with incoming join and overlap forms omitted. After: complete contextual shaping and optical spacing. A shared curved arrow marks all bottom joins across L–A–X–E–D; the upper arrow marks the open XE and ED top corners that preserve readability. The color choices stay fixed.

assets.title: Optical spacing in COOL
assets.caption: Before and after the OO pair-spacing adjustment. Only the first O’s advance changes, from 950 to 830 font units: the second O moves 24 design pixels closer. Red dotted lines span the gold-to-gold gap in both rows. Colors, glyph forms, and the other pair adjustments stay fixed.

assets.title: Let the strokes meet: LAZY
assets.caption: Actual earlier tapered font versus the finished full-stroke overlaps. Enlargements show the LA, AZ, and ZY intersections.

assets.title: A hairline between perfectly touching shapes
assets.caption: Same text, 127 px/em, and 0.125 px horizontal origin before and after fixing the hairline gap. Nearest-neighbor enlargements preserve the individual pixels.

assets.title: Different glyphs. The same text.
assets.caption: Illustrated typing, selection, and copy sequence, rendered from actual HarfBuzz-shaped text. The gap between HELLO and JAMAICA is half a flag’s height. This is an illustration rather than a browser recording.
